about: Script-only cases for check_evidence.py 0.4.0. Written on 2026-11-14, before the script was changed; every label was fixed when the case was written. kind: correct = a true claim with its right quote (should pass); wrong = a claim with a changed number or name (must be flagged); limit = a true claim with a number the document does not state or rounds too coarsely (flagged on purpose).
